notes: Remixa is on your phone now: open the Phone page, scan the code, and schedule, submit and watch your renders from anywhere - even with your computer off. Everything syncs by itself. This build also fixes 2.9.54 not opening on some PCs, and the brightness variation setting now does exactly what it says.
_urls: urls are GitHub Release assets (stable, public, direct .exe/.dmg) and sha256 pins the exact binary - the 2.9.8+ updater verifies the download against it before offering to install. Assets use customer-friendly names (Remixa-Windows.exe / Remixa-Mac.dmg); the release TAG carries the version. Mac dmg is signed + notarized + stapled (no Gatekeeper warning) from the cloud-Mac CI. Both platforms current as of 2.9.55.
